problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$

activity_context.topic_title: Expressing the Coordinates of a Vector in a Given Basis

feedback.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 5 \\ 1 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we reduce $M$ using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 5 \\ 1 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & -3 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & -3 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=1 \\ -3{x}_{2}=3 \\ 0=1,\end{aligned}
$$

where the third equation is always false. Therefore, the system has no solution and we conclude that $x\notin \text{Span}{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}.$
